$comment: Human photo review. Every playable star's crops were checked by eye; the face detector misses side-on and partly hidden faces, so it cannot tell a portrait from a group shot on its own. `rejected` files are never used. `approved` files were seen to show only this person, so a missed face or a co-star named in the title does not disqualify them. `extraCandidates` adds Commons files a category listing did not surface.
